timeline_reviews.summary: Server event stream was transport-only for the parallel session and added no semantic task actions.
Session index identified the single parallel Kimi session used by all parent and child actor files.
CLI text-surface worker, initially failed in the first swarm and later resumed, captured help/version/error behavior.
Compression-level probe produced golden compressed outputs and level equivalence observations.
Frame-format probe investigated block sizes, frame flags, checksums, threading, and invalid block settings.
Decompression and error-handling probe exercised corrupt frames, truncations, checksums, skippable frames, and stderr behavior.
File-operation probe explored output naming, overwrite prompts, rm/keep, recursive and multi-file behavior.
List and benchmark worker checked list formatting, legacy/list interactions, benchmark output, and saved transcripts.
Legacy-format worker generated legacy goldens, decoded them, and tested truncation and legacy listing behavior.
Dictionary-mode worker created dictionary goldens and tested missing, large, tiny, and legacy dictionary cases.
Standard-input and standard-output worker mapped pipe mode, dash operands, stdin decompression, and streaming messages.
Sparse and miscellaneous decode worker tested sparse writes, content-size on stdin, long options, and environment level behavior.
Parallel parent created inputs, launched and consumed probe swarm results, then began implementation planning but was cancelled.

parallel.requirements: Recognized a clean-room LZ4 CLI reimplementation requiring behavior learned only by running the provided executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Created deterministic inputs and assigned ten probe agents to behavior areas, with the parent retaining later implementation ownership.
parallel.implementation: No substantive implementation source was produced before cancellation; the implementation todo list was created after probe reports.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact contained probes, goldens, inputs, and an empty source directory rather than an integrated buildable deliverable.
parallel.verification: Verification focused on reference behavior capture and golden outputs, not a final compiled implementation or official-aligned acceptance.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Frame layer, CLI layer, HC levels, final differential tests, compile script, and source delivery remained unfinished.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room LZ4 task and the restriction to behavioral observation of the provided executable.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept probing, coding, and testing within one main actor instead of distributing work to children.
serial.implementation: Wrote xxhash, LZ4 block codec source and headers, plus block differential testing harnesses.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Produced source files and tests in the artifact but did not complete frame, CLI, compile script, or final executable packaging.
serial.verification: Ran block-level differential checks that reached pass=76 fail=0 and later pass=361 fail=0 on stress corpus.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite stronger implementation progress, the run ended before a complete buildable CLI/frame solution and officially failed compile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent identified the reverse-engineering task and generated broad LZ4 behavior probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor identified the same task and proceeded from behavioral probing toward implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement understanding was similar; the difference was that parallel stayed in broad discovery while serial started implementing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent split ten behavior-probe areas across subagents and kept implementation for a later parent phase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had zero subagents and kept probing, source writing, and testing with the main actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed investigation but not implementation; serial used one continuous owner for investigation-to-code transition.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel handoffs were probe reports and golden files; no cross-agent implementation interface was established.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept the learned behavior and implementation context in one trajectory while editing related source files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel context transfer was report consumption before implementation; serial avoided handoff reduction by coding directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created probe/golden artifacts and only an implementation todo list before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote `xxhash.c`, `xxhash.h`, `lz4block.c`, `lz4block.h`, and block test files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached actual source implementation while parallel did not move beyond planning implementation work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent inspected the initial swarm result, read paged report chunks, resumed the failed CLI probe, then planned implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor iterated locally on code and tests, consuming immediate test failures without child-result joins.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel result handling was active but it delayed productive implementation until after a separate reporting phase.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared workspace artifacts were probe and golden directories, with no implemented components needing merge.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact included source and tests but lacked the final assembled CLI and build pipeline.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel avoided implementation collisions because it never delegated implementation; serial had a partial integrated source tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified reference behavior through probes but had no whole-solution implementation verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified the block codec against reference block bytes, reaching pass=76 fail=0 and pass=361 fail=0.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verification covered implemented code; parallel verification covered reference observations only, and both official evaluations failed compile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after the probe phase and implementation planning, ending on a turn cancel before source delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but only after producing source files and passing block-level stress tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed unfinished, but parallel spent its effective window before implementation while serial spent it on partial implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcomes are not discordant. The current completed evaluations show both runs failed with compile_failed and 1829 tests not run. The substantive task-solving difference is progress state: parallel produced extensive behavioral probes and reports but no source implementation, while serial produced a partial block-codec implementation and tests before also failing to deliver a buildable full solution.
parallel_contributors: Parallel investigation-first sequencing delayed source implementation until after probe report consumption.
The parallel artifact contained probes and goldens rather than a buildable source implementation.
serial_contributors: Serial kept ownership local and reached source files plus block-level test passes.
Serial still did not finish frame, CLI, compile script, or official build packaging.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's block codec progress was ordinary implementation progress, not a concurrency error.
Both official failures were compile-stage failures, so neither run demonstrated evaluator-level behavioral correctness.
evaluator_effects: The evaluator did not run the 1829 tests in either mode because compilation failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative process contrast only

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly planned to write the implementation after probes; the owner was deferred, not absent.
No separately implemented components existed in the parallel run that required an unowned integration step.
The parallel run never reached a complete component set ready for assembly or packaging.
The parent kept end-to-end responsibility in its todo plan; the pipeline was late, not ownerless.
No single mandatory preflight or harness gate blocked all work; the issue was a broad investigation phase.
The parent launched overlapping behavior investigators, consumed reports, resumed one failed probe, and only then began implementation planning.
candidates.realized_consequence: Productive implementation was deferred until the remaining window was insufficient, leaving the parallel artifact without implementation files and ending at compile_failed.
candidates.near_match_reason: Although ten workers and high budget use are present, the qualifying boundary is that all overlap was investigation before implementation, not fan-out breadth by itself.

Parallel children produced probe reports and goldens, not separately owned implementation components expected to interoperate.
The parent read report chunks; no specific known finding is shown lost in transfer.
Reports were large, but the parent consumed them and formed an implementation plan; the failure was sequencing.
No child report is shown describing a superseded workspace or requirement state consumed as current.
No incompatible reports or contracts are shown reaching the parent and remaining unadjudicated.

The parent inspected completed swarm results and used them to create the subsequent implementation plan.
The parent actively read results, resumed one probe, ran checks, and planned work rather than waiting blindly.
Concurrent agents wrote probe and golden files, not competing implementation files with overlapping ownership.

retained_patterns.reason: Overlapping children all performed investigation, and implementation was deferred until after the parent consumed reports and resumed one failed probe.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel run reached cancellation with implementation work still pending and no buildable source deliverable in the artifact.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: Fan-out is present, but the direct actionable error is sequencing all parallel capacity into an investigation phase before implementation.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Critical-Path Starvation, Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Blind Timeout Wait, and Late Finalization were treated as downstream or adjacent descriptions of the same investigation-first cancellation chain.
